headings: Scholarships for students starting in the Winter 2026 term or after
intake_texts: Scholarships for students starting in the Winter 2026 term or after

Be newly admitted for the Winter 2026 term or later in an approved English-language undergraduate program in one of the following faculties: Arts, Engineering, Health Sciences, Science, Social Sciences or the Telfer School of Management.

criteria_texts: Number of awards: Unlimited. This is an automatic scholarship. All eligible students are considered for this award and will be notified at the time of their admission.
Be an international student with a valid study permit.
Have a minimum admission average of 80%.
Canadian citizens with dual citizenship (Canada and another country) are not eligible since they already qualify for Canadian tuition rates.
This scholarship is only available to international students who pay international tuition fees. Students paying domestic fees are not eligible.
